sections.title: The letter te
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (te) /te/. It makes one main sound. You hear it in the word (tiempo) /ˈtjem.po/, which means time, weather. This letter has only one sound in standard speech.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Touch the back of your upper front teeth with the tip of your tongue. Stop the air completely for a brief moment. Release the tongue without blowing out extra air. Your vocal cords do not vibrate. Hold your hand before your mouth. You should feel no puff of air.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: This letter always keeps its one sound in all regular words. You hear it at the start of a word in (taza) /ˈta.θa/. You also hear it between vowels in (patio) /ˈpa.tjo/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not make this sound aspirated, like the t in tea. A sound is aspirated when followed by a small puff of air. Keep the air clean and stop any puff. Also, place your tongue on your upper teeth, not on the gum ridge behind them.
